question: Brief description of what TinyPM does (1-2 sentences)
answer: TinyPM is the first AI project manager built     as a team of specialized agents—an Overseer      that coordinates, a Scribe that remembers        everything across every session, an Artificer    that executes, and a Mentor that verifies        quality before anything reaches you.                                                              Unlike single-AI tools that forget your          project the moment you close the tab, TinyPM     learns your patterns, anticipates what you       need before you ask, and delivers work that's    already been reviewed.
